B.domain: Subtracting fractions and mixed numbers (including whole numbers), with simplification to lowest terms

skills.name: Common denominator conversion
skills.definition: Find a least common denominator (LCD) and rewrite one or both fractions as equivalent fractions with that denominator.
inclusion_criteria: Solution explicitly finds an LCD/LCM for two denominators
Solution converts fractions to equivalent forms with a common denominator before subtracting (e.g., a/b -> x/LCD)
exclusion_criteria: Fractions already share a denominator and no conversion is performed
Only simplifying/reducing a fraction without changing to a common denominator

skills.name: Subtract fraction parts
skills.definition: Compute the difference of two fractions once they have the same denominator by subtracting numerators and keeping the denominator.
inclusion_criteria: Solution performs (a−b)/d or x/d − y/d = (x−y)/d
Includes cases where the result is 0/d or negative before any regrouping
exclusion_criteria: Only finding an LCD/converting without actually subtracting
Only borrowing/regrouping steps without executing the fraction subtraction

skills.name: Mixed/whole rewriting
skills.definition: Rewrite numbers into a form suitable for subtraction (e.g., separate whole and fractional parts, convert mixed to improper, or express a whole number with a chosen fractional denominator).
inclusion_criteria: Solution rewrites a whole number as a mixed number with 0/d or as an equivalent fraction (e.g., 4 = 12/3)
Solution converts a mixed number to an improper fraction (e.g., 4 1/3 -> 13/3)
Solution simplifies a fractional part inside a mixed number before subtracting (e.g., 4/10 -> 2/5)
exclusion_criteria: Straight subtraction of already-compatible forms with no rewriting
Borrowing/regrouping steps (handled by S04)

skills.name: Regroup and simplify result
skills.definition: When needed, borrow/regroup 1 whole into fractional units to avoid a negative fractional part, then simplify and express the final answer in an appropriate form (integer, proper fraction, or mixed number).
inclusion_criteria: Solution borrows 1 from the whole part and adds d/d to the fraction part (regrouping)
Solution reduces a fraction to lowest terms or converts 0/d to 0 as part of finishing
Solution converts an improper fraction result to a mixed number as the final expression
exclusion_criteria: Only performing the initial fraction subtraction without any regrouping or final-form simplification
Only finding LCD/converting denominators (S01) or rewriting inputs (S03)

C.domain: Subtracting fractions and mixed numbers with simplification

skills.name: Common denominator conversion
skills.definition: Find a common denominator (typically the LCD) and rewrite one or both fractions as equivalent fractions with that denominator.
inclusion_criteria: Solution explicitly finds an LCD/common denominator
Solution converts fractions (or fractional parts of mixed numbers) to equivalent forms with a shared denominator before subtracting
exclusion_criteria: Fractions already share a denominator and no conversion is performed
Only simplifying/reducing a fraction without changing denominators to match another fraction

skills.name: Subtract fractional quantities
skills.definition: Perform the subtraction once denominators are aligned (including subtracting numerators for like denominators and handling zero fractional parts).
inclusion_criteria: Subtracts two fractions with the same denominator (numerator subtraction shown)
Subtracts fractional parts within mixed-number subtraction (including cases like 7/8 − 0 or 0/8 results)
exclusion_criteria: Only finds LCD/converts but does not execute the subtraction
Only borrows/regroups without actually carrying out the fraction subtraction

skills.name: Mixed-number structure handling
skills.definition: Rewrite or interpret whole numbers and mixed/improper mixed numbers into a form suitable for subtraction (e.g., separate whole and fraction parts, or convert to improper fractions).
inclusion_criteria: Rewrites a whole number as a mixed number with a zero fraction or as an equivalent fraction with a chosen denominator
Converts a mixed number (including one with an improper fractional part) into an improper fraction or otherwise restructures terms before subtracting
Separates subtraction into whole-part and fraction-part components
exclusion_criteria: Pure fraction-minus-fraction problems with no whole-number/mixed-number rewriting
Borrowing/regrouping steps after a negative fractional part is found (tag S04 instead)

skills.name: Regroup and simplify result
skills.definition: When needed, borrow/regroup between whole and fractional parts to resolve a negative fractional difference, and express the final answer in simplest form (reduce and/or convert to integer/mixed number).
inclusion_criteria: Borrows 1 from the whole number and adds an equivalent 1 (e.g., 5/5, 12/12) to the fractional part to make subtraction possible
Simplifies/reduces the resulting fraction (including turning 0/n into 0)
Converts an improper fraction result into a mixed number or integer as the final form
exclusion_criteria: Straight subtraction with no regrouping and no simplification/conversion step shown
Only finding LCD or only performing numerator subtraction without any final-form adjustment

A.domain: Subtracting fractions and mixed numbers with simplification

skills.name: Common denominator conversion
skills.definition: Find a least common denominator (LCD) and rewrite one or both fractions as equivalent fractions with that denominator.
inclusion_criteria: Solution explicitly finds an LCD/LCM of denominators
Solution converts fractions to equivalent forms with a common denominator before subtracting
exclusion_criteria: Fractions already share a denominator and no conversion is performed
Only simplifying/reducing a fraction without changing to a common denominator

skills.name: Subtract fractional parts
skills.definition: Perform fraction subtraction once denominators match (including subtracting numerators and handling zero as a fraction).
inclusion_criteria: Subtracts two fractions with the same denominator by subtracting numerators
Subtracts a fractional part from another fractional part within a mixed-number subtraction
Computes a zero fraction result such as 0/8 or 0/3 as part of subtraction
exclusion_criteria: Only finds an LCD/converts fractions but does not execute the subtraction
Only simplifies/reduces after subtraction without actually subtracting

skills.name: Mixed/whole rewriting
skills.definition: Rewrite numbers into a form suitable for subtraction (e.g., separate whole and fractional parts, convert mixed to improper, or write a whole number with a chosen denominator).
inclusion_criteria: Rewrites a whole number as a mixed number with 0/n or as an equivalent fraction with a specified denominator
Converts a mixed number to an improper fraction (or otherwise rewrites a mixed number to enable subtraction)
Simplifies a fractional part inside a mixed number before subtracting (e.g., 4/10 to 2/5)
exclusion_criteria: Only subtracts already-compatible forms without any rewriting
Only reduces the final answer after subtraction (no preparatory rewriting)

skills.name: Regroup and simplify result
skills.definition: Regroup/borrow when a fractional part becomes negative and express the final result in simplest appropriate form (reduce, convert 0 to integer, or form a mixed number).
inclusion_criteria: Borrows 1 from the whole number to make the fractional subtraction nonnegative (adds n/n to the fraction)
Combines whole and fractional parts after subtraction to form the final value
Simplifies the resulting fraction (reduces) and/or converts 0/k to 0 or improper to mixed as part of finalization
exclusion_criteria: Fraction subtraction does not require borrowing/regrouping and no simplification/final-form conversion is shown
Only performs the raw subtraction without any regrouping or simplification/final formatting
